Subject: AWS Co-sell: Pathfinder Solutions — Co-sell intro & onboarding sync

Hi Jordan / Priya / Samir,

Thanks for taking the time today. Pathfinder flagged interest in a marketplace-led procurement route once the POC finishes, and Samir suggested we do a short co-sell intro + mutual action plan so all parties have clear next steps.

Attached is a working Mutual Action Plan (Pathfinder_MAP_v1.2.xlsx) — it's intentionally lightweight: scope, success metrics, procurement milestones, and the owner for each item. Can we lock a 30-minute intro this week to align on the MAP and confirm the AWS co-sell path (APN listing checklist / timeline)? Proposed windows:
- Wed 8/11 10:00–10:30 PT
- Thu 8/12 09:00–09:30 PT
- Fri 8/13 13:00–13:30 PT

Ask from our side: if you (Jordan/Priya) can confirm procurement timeline and any required compliance evidence, and Samir can outline the AWS marketplace/co-sell requirements that would accelerate listing.

Karthik and Laura — I'll run the call and would like a short readiness note from each: Karthik (high-level cost model + expected instance profile for POC->prod), Laura (security gate checklist & SOC/attestation notes).

Thanks — Kim

--
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive, North America
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0124

Subject: Re: AWS Co-sell: Pathfinder Solutions — Co-sell intro & onboarding sync

Kim, Samir — thanks, this looks good. Thu 8/12 09:00 PT works best for our team (I can send a calendar invite).

Quick context so the call is productive: Pathfinder has a procurement window targeting late Q3 for vendor selection, but final approval hinges on a short vendor security questionnaire and an estimate for 6–12 months of production usage (approx. 3–5 inference instances initially). Also want to confirm whether listing via the AWS Marketplace would allow us to use an existing enterprise contract or if a separate marketplace contract/term is required.

I'll aim to have our procurement lead (Priya) on the call as well; she'll be the primary contact for contract/timing questions.

—Jordan
Director of Product, Pathfinder Solutions
jordan.lee@pathfindersolutions.com

- Laura: bring a short checklist of the security evidence we can provide immediately (SOC 2 scope, data residency options, audit log availability) and call out anything that will take >2 weeks.
- Kim: I'll run the agenda and own the MAP doc; please review the attached architecture diagram (redwood-inference-arch-diagram.pdf) and flag any redlines by tomorrow EOD.

Attachments: pricing-estimate-Pathfinder.xlsx (placeholder) — Karthik, you can overwrite with numbers; Laura, reference the security checklist in our internal drive.
